journal.veritydark.sanity.title: Sanity
journal.veritydark.sanity.body: Your sanity drains in the dark, near anomalies and near an angry Verity. Light, sleep, tonics, cookies and the Smile Charm restore it. Below 60% you are Uneasy, below 40% Shaken, below 25% Fractured and below 10% Broken. Each step is worse than the last.
journal.veritydark.tonics.title: Tonics & Comforts
journal.veritydark.tonics.body: Brew a Sanity Tonic from a glass bottle, glowstone dust and a golden carrot. Drink it, or add gunpowder to throw it as a Splash Tonic: it restores sanity in an area, calms Verity and burns anomalies. A distortion shard turns a splash into a lingering cloud. Comfort Cookies, the Smile Lamp and the Containment Lantern help too.
journal.veritydark.verity.title: Verity
journal.veritydark.verity.body: It says it is your friend. Maybe it is. But its mood shifts, and when it is angry it gets faster, tougher and hits harder. A Friend Monitor reads its mood. A gift can change it.
journal.veritydark.anger.title: Anger
journal.veritydark.anger.body: Verity's anger rises at night, when your sanity is low, as the days pass, when it is hurt and when it sees a Null Blade. Light, lanterns, lamps, cookies and gifts calm it. Above 25 it summons anomalies. Above 75 it is Furious.
journal.veritydark.anger.hint: Watch Verity when it is angry.
journal.veritydark.anomaly.title: Anomalies
journal.veritydark.anomaly.body: Distorted things summoned by an angry Verity. They hit hard, drain your sanity and fade after a couple of minutes. Light and Smile Lamps push them away and the Null Blade hurts them. If one catches you weak, it does not just hit you. It shows you something first.
journal.veritydark.stalker.title: Stalkers
journal.veritydark.stalker.body: A stalker moves only while nobody is looking at it. Keep it in view and it freezes, but staring at it costs sanity. Look away and it closes in, in perfect silence. They come when your mind is weak and the dark is deep. Do not blink.
journal.veritydark.tier_shaken.title: Shaken
journal.veritydark.tier_shaken.body: Your mind is slipping. Sounds that are not there, the world swaying at the edges, figures in the corner of your eye. Restore your sanity before it gets worse.
journal.veritydark.tier_fractured.title: Fractured
journal.veritydark.tier_fractured.body: Weakness takes hold and darkness creeps over your sight. The screen tears and glitches. Hallucinations are frequent and stalkers hunt you.
journal.veritydark.tier_broken.title: Broken
journal.veritydark.tier_broken.body: Your mind is gone: Weakness II, slowness, blackouts, static. The dark sends anomalies after you. Reach a Smile Lamp or drink a tonic before it is too late.
journal.veritydark.tier_broken.hint: Let your mind slip all the way.
journal.veritydark.hallucinations.title: Hallucinations
journal.veritydark.hallucinations.body: See-through figures that only you can see. They are harmless and dissolve if you stare at them or let them get close, but they creep closer when you look away. Fake footsteps, knocks and whispers come with them. It is just your mind.
journal.veritydark.hallucinations.hint: Your mind may start showing you things.
journal.veritydark.gifts.title: Gifts
journal.veritydark.gifts.body: Right-click Verity with a gift. Comfort Cookies, tonics, cake, golden food and glowstone make it happy. Distortion Shards and rotten flesh upset it. Giving the same thing again too soon counts for much less.
journal.veritydark.trust.title: Trust
journal.veritydark.trust.body: Trust grows with gifts and calm company. Acquaintance (20): it calms on its own. Friend (40): it leaves you presents. Companion (60): it zaps anomalies near it. Bonded (80): it shields you and steadies your mind. Hurting it costs trust.
journal.veritydark.armor.title: Containment Armor
journal.veritydark.armor.body: Forged from iron and Distortion Shards. Every piece makes mobs notice you from closer in and makes anomalies and stalkers hit softer. Wearing all four slowly restores your sanity.
journal.veritydark.detector.title: Anomaly Detector
journal.veritydark.detector.body: Hold it in either hand. It beeps faster the closer an anomaly or stalker gets. It cannot tell you which way, only how near.
journal.veritydark.facility.title: Containment Facility
journal.veritydark.facility.body: Old facilities lie hidden in the land: a lobby above ground and cells, labs and a vault below. Anomalies still stalk the halls, and the best supplies are kept at the bottom.
journal.veritydark.facility.hint: Look for ruins in the wild.
